title: Chicken Florentine
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift from the exact 3.5x scale noted per line where it exceeds 5%.

ruled_substitutions.ruling: commodity-registrar 2026-08-15: reuse existing white-wine id NOT permitted into the recipe (priced at one store, zero comparison-board rows, no recipe-board row). Wine replaced with additional Chicken Broth plus a small acid per standing estate policy (precedent: ropa-vieja-beef-burrito writer_notes).
ruled_substitutions.implemented_as: 0.75 cup (source scale) added to the Chicken Broth line, plus White Wine Vinegar at 6/7 tbsp source scale (inside the prescribed 2 tsp to 1 Tbsp range), scaled to 3 tbsp at 14 servings. Vinegar chosen over lemon juice to match the ropa vieja precedent.
ruled_substitutions.writer_note: add the vinegar with the broth before the cream goes in so it cooks into the sauce; taste at the end, the sauce should read bright, not sour

ingredients.notes: RULED 2026-08-15 after coordinator macro check: the source's published nutrition (614 cal, 44 g protein per serving) reconstructs to ~161-170 g raw breast per serving, so the source's cutlet is a ~6 oz piece, not the 100 g a halved 200 g densities breast implies. Grams moved 1361 -> 2381 (5.25 lb x 453.592, measure and grams agree exactly). Same product concept and price class as the chicken-breast commodity. Recompute ~574 cal / ~45 g protein per serving, matching the source within rounding
exact scale is 0.875 cups; dredging flour scales sublinearly (it coats the surface, excess is discarded), quantized down to 0.75 cups
